## a tag destination
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"tag:db:5432\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="tag:db:5432" protocol="tcp" want="Accept" got="Drop"

## a host alias
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"web:443\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="web:443" protocol="tcp" want="Accept" got="Drop"

## an IPv4 address with its protocol
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Drop, got: Accept"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="192.0.2.10:22" protocol="tcp" want="Drop" got="Accept"

## an IPv4 address with no protocol clause
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\": want: Drop, got: Accept"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="192.0.2.10:22" protocol="" want="Drop" got="Accept"

## a bracketed IPv6 address
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"[2001:db8::10]:443\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="[2001:db8::10]:443" protocol="tcp" want="Accept" got="Drop"

## ICMP, port 0, with its protocol
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:0\" (protocol \"icmp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="192.0.2.10:0" protocol="icmp" want="Accept" got="Drop"

## ICMP, port 0, no protocol clause
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:0\": want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="192.0.2.10:0" protocol="" want="Accept" got="Drop"

## the canary with acls absent
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.1:1\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Drop, got: Accept"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="192.0.2.1:1" protocol="tcp" want="Drop" got="Accept"

## the canary with acls empty
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.1:1\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="192.0.2.1:1" protocol="tcp" want="Accept" got="Drop"

## an SSH test
line:  "[ssh test error]: src \"tag:p\" at \"100.64.0.1\", dst \"tag:db\" at \"100.64.0.2\", ssh user \"root\": want: \"accept\" got: \"deny\""
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=true dst="tag:db" protocol="" want="accept" got="deny"

## an SSH test, the other way
line:  "[ssh test error]: src \"tag:p\" at \"100.64.0.1\", dst \"tag:db\" at \"100.64.0.2\", ssh user \"root\": want: \"deny\" got: \"accept\""
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=true dst="tag:db" protocol="" want="deny" got="accept"

## a service (constructed from the grammar, not observed)
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"svc:web:443\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="svc:web:443" protocol="tcp" want="Accept" got="Drop"

## no heading (constructed from the grammar, not observed)
line:  "address \"198.51.100.7:80\" (protocol \"udp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="198.51.100.7:80" protocol="udp" want="Accept" got="Drop"

## a destination with a quote and a backslash (constructed from the grammar, not observed)
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"tag:a\\\"b\\\\c:22\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Drop, got: Accept"
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=false dst="tag:a\"b\\c:22" protocol="tcp" want="Drop" got="Accept"

## an SSH test with no heading (constructed from the grammar, not observed)
line:  "src \"group:eng\" at \"100.64.0.3\", dst \"tag:db\" at \"100.64.0.2\", ssh user \"admin\": want: \"accept\" got: \"deny\""
parse: kind=assertion_failed ssh=true dst="tag:db" protocol="" want="accept" got="deny"

## a CIDR
line:  "[acl test error]: user or host is invalid: bad user spec given: \"198.51.100.0/24\""
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## autogroup:internet
line:  "[acl test error]: address autogroup:internet:22: is not a valid address"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## a tag that is not defined
line:  "[acl test error]: user or host is invalid: tag not found: \"tag:missing\""
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## the summary line
line:  "test(s) failed"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## an empty line
line:  ""
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## the heading alone
line:  "[acl test error]: "
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## a bare message
line:  "something else went wrong"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## both verdicts the same
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Drop, got: Drop"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## a verdict in lower case
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: accept, got: drop"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## text after the verdict
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\" (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop (twice)"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## text before the heading
line:  "error: [acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\": want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## two headings
line:  "[acl test error]: [acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\": want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## an address that is not quoted
line:  "[acl test error]: address 192.0.2.10:22: want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## an address that does not unquote
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"tag:\\q:22\": want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## a protocol that is not closed
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\" (protocol \"tcp\": want: Accept, got: Drop"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## a missing comma
line:  "[acl test error]: address \"192.0.2.10:22\": want: Accept got: Drop"
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## an SSH verdict outside accept and deny
line:  "[ssh test error]: src \"tag:p\" at \"100.64.0.1\", dst \"tag:db\" at \"100.64.0.2\", ssh user \"root\": want: \"check\" got: \"deny\""
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## an SSH line with a field missing
line:  "[ssh test error]: src \"tag:p\" at \"100.64.0.1\", dst \"tag:db\" at \"100.64.0.2\": want: \"accept\" got: \"deny\""
parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

## an SSH line with text after it

parse: kind=test_unevaluable ssh=false dst="" protocol="" want="" got=""

line:  "[acl test error]: address `192.0.2.10:22` (protocol \"tcp\"): want: Accept, got: Drop"
